description: This PHP source file defines the PlotArea class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, specifically related to chart plotting. It manages plot series, layout, fill properties, and other attributes of a chart's plotting area.

classes.name: PlotArea
classes.description: Represents the plotting area of a chart, managing series, layout, fill, and gridline properties.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a new PlotArea with optional layout and series.

methods.name: getLayout
methods.description: Returns the layout object for the plot area.

methods.name: getPlotGroupCount
methods.description: Returns the number of plot groups (series).

methods.name: getPlotSeriesCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of plot series.

methods.name: getPlotGroup
methods.description: Returns the array of plot series.

methods.name: getPlotGroupByIndex
methods.description: Returns a specific plot series by index.

methods.name: setPlotSeries
methods.description: Sets the array of plot series.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes all plot series with a specified worksheet.

methods.name: setNoFill
methods.description: Sets whether the plot area has no fill.

methods.name: getNoFill
methods.description: Returns whether the plot area has no fill.

methods.name: setGradientFillProperties
methods.description: Sets gradient fill stops and angle.

methods.name: getGradientFillStops
methods.description: Returns the gradient fill stops array.

methods.name: getUseUpBars
methods.description: Returns whether up bars are used.

methods.name: setUseUpBars
methods.description: Sets whether to use up bars.

methods.name: getUseDownBars
methods.description: Returns whether down bars are used.

methods.name: setUseDownBars
methods.description: Sets whether to use down bars.
